title: Elige la correcta
intro: [curious] Elige la palabra que va en el hueco. Tienes unos segundos.

full_script: [curious] Elige la palabra que va en el hueco. Tienes unos segundos. This soup is too hot. I don't have enough money. You're old enough to decide. Ahora, nivel intermedio. It's too late to go out now. Is it warm enough for you? She talks too much. I've had enough! I'm leaving. Y ahora, nivel experto. The box is too heavy for me to lift. Funnily enough, I was thinking the same. You can never be too careful. Tres aciertos, nivel básico. Siete, intermedio. Diez, experto de verdad. [curious] ¿En cuál fallaste? Dímelo en los comentarios.
